import sys, pathlib
font = pathlib.Path('/usr/share/fonts/truetype/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf').read_bytes()
content = b'BT /F1 12 Tf 1 0 0 0 10 10 Tm (A) Tj ET
'
objs=[]
def add(b):
    if isinstance(b,str): b=b.encode('latin1')
    objs.append(b)
add('1 0 obj
<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>
endobj
')
add('2 0 obj
<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>
endobj
')
add('3 0 obj
<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 200 200] /Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>
endobj
')
add('4 0 obj
<< /Type /Font /Subtype /TrueType /BaseFont /DejaVuSans /FirstChar 65 /LastChar 65 /Widths [684] /Encoding /WinAnsiEncoding /FontDescriptor 6 0 R >>
endobj
')
add(b'5 0 obj
<< /Length %d >>
stream
'%len(content)+content+b'endstream
endobj
')
add('6 0 obj
<< /Type /FontDescriptor /FontName /DejaVuSans /Flags 32 /FontBBox [-1021 -463 1793 1232] /ItalicAngle 0 /Ascent 928 /Descent -236 /CapHeight 729 /StemV 80 /FontFile2 7 0 R >>
endobj
')
add(b'7 0 obj
<< /Length %d /Length1 %d >>
stream
'%(len(font),len(font))+font+b'
endstream
endobj
')
out=b'%PDF-1.4
%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3
'
off=[0]
for o in objs:
    off.append(len(out)); out += o
xref=len(out)
out += f'xref
0 {len(objs)+1}
0000000000 65535 f 
'.encode('ascii')
for x in off[1:]: out += f'{x:010d} 00000 n 
'.encode('ascii')
out += f'trailer
<< /Size {len(objs)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>
startxref
{xref}
%%EOF
'.encode('ascii')
path=sys.argv[1]
open(path,'wb').write(out)
print(path, len(out))
